2 entirely different conditions for dribbling urine in male dogs
1) Sphincter dyssnergia...due to neurological damage to the bladder and sphincter
causing paralysis of the bladder wall and spasms of the urinary sphincter....get
overflow incontinence and dribbling of urine
2) Male incompetence of the urinary sphincter....due to weakness in the ability
of the sphincter to hold back urine ( this is the opposite of sphincter dyssnergia
treat with drugs that improve sphincter control...ie hormones, alpha 1 agonists like PPA
Most times it is the first cause in male dogs especially older ones
